description: B-25J Mitchell mounted on a roundabout since the early 1980s (installed under mayor Humberto Coronel Rivas). Marked FAB-542; Los Tiempos (Feb 2023) says it arrived from Venezuela in 1973, while fleet lists record the true c/n as unknown ('the aircraft still defies identification', airhistory.net photo of 23 October 2015). In 2022 the FAB tried to move it to the El Alto museum but residents and the municipality refused. Photographed in place February 2023.
museum_name: Plaza General de Aviación Walter Arze Rojas B-25 Monument, Cochabamba
